_about: Master section registry for En Garde Gazette (Frank 2026-10-20). Being configured section by section with Frank; CONTENT-HIERARCHY.md remains canonical until migration is complete. Readable table will be generated from this file.

fields.priority: core | high | medium | low (words, not numbers). core = never cut; low = first cut when long, first pulled in to fill when short. Within a tier, Desk uses judgment on the week.
fields.size: min / typical / max that still reads well
fields.placement: page / column-span hints (priority, not page assignment)
fields.rules: house rules: section-specific notes and lines not to cross that other fields don't cover

sections.name: Lead Story
sections.shelf_life: time_sensitive: the week's biggest epee news
sections.supplier: desk finds and writes; frank vets at budget; Frank's tips count as sources
sections.lead_time: picked Monday after the weekend; can swap late if a bigger result posts
rules: Pick order: strong club result first, then national/NJ
A late big club result bumps the planned lead to a page-1 feature

sections.name: Club Results
sections.frequency_detail: only when there's a strong result or a qualification
sections.supplier: desk from FencingTracker/AskFRED; Frank's chat tips count; names as on official pages
sections.lead_time: as results post; keep checking until compose
rules: Strong results only (podium, top 8, notable climb)
Qualifying is the result (Frank 2026-10-20): whether someone qualified matters most, and it's sensitive; print 'qualified for X', placement not the headline (omit by default)
No birth years; no fencer schools

sections.name: Ratings Earned
sections.status: stays its own box (Frank 2026-10-20); full config pending
rules: Separate from Club Results: worth celebrating on its own

sections.name: Featured Bout
sections.frequency_detail: semi-regular, roughly every 2-3 issues, when Frank has watched a bout worth recommending; never forced

size.max: ~250w in-depth review, only when the bout is exceptional

sections.shelf_life: evergreen while the video stays online
sections.supplier: frank (bout link + optional screenshot + his take); desk writes
sections.lead_time: a few days; can sit on the bench ready to fill
sections.placement: any page; 1 column, 2 if review-length with a screenshot
rules: Credit the video every time with a SHORTENED link (e.g. youtu.be/<id>), never the long URL
Screenshot only from Frank; check the video's usage terms before printing
Insights stay grounded in what's on the video; opinions labeled

sections.name: Travel Tournaments (working name; Road Trip dropped since half the trips are flights; Frank still choosing)
sections.status: new (2026-10-20), configuring; deliberate revival of travel, limited to national tournaments (the 2026-10-06 cut of general travel stands)
sections.frequency_detail: every national tournament (NACs, March NAC, Summer Nationals), ~4-8 weeks out; most club kids attend only Summer Nationals and the March NAC, older kids go to more, so those two get the fullest treatment
sections.shelf_life: time_sensitive: stale once the tournament passes
sections.lead_time: start ~6-8 weeks before the event so it can run 4-8 weeks out
sections.role: occasional feature; encourages families to travel to nationals
rules: Be very selective with places: skip anything a quick Google search would surface; favor few, non-obvious, season/weather-appropriate picks that fit a tournament schedule
Venue basics and practical tips for families

sections.name: Photo from History
rules: Attribution kept SHORT (Frank 2026-10-20): one line, e.g. 'Photo: Author / Source, CC BY-SA 3.0 (cropped)'. Author, source, license and a change note only; no file names or long URLs
